statements.t: Over the next 12 months, we expect to fund operating costs, planned drilling and completion expenditures, and capital calls as they are made from cash on hand, cash generated by operations, and available borrowings under our credit facility.
Beyond the next 12 months, we expect operating cash flow to be our primary source of funding for ongoing development and any remaining capital commitments.
The Company currently plans to participate in the drilling and completion of 55 horizontal wells at an estimated cost of approximately $1,300,000 for the fiscal year ending March 31, 2027.
The Company also expects to expend approximately $500,000 for the completion of 20 horizontal wells in which the Company participated during fiscal 2026.
We are participating in other projects and are reviewing projects in which we may participate.

The Company currently expects to participate in the drilling of 55 horizontal wells and the completion of 20 horizontal wells at an estimated aggregate cost of approximately $1.8 million during the fiscal year ending March 31, 2027, of which approximately $900,000 has been expended to date.
